intent: Recheck the previously reported false-pass risk in the pinned ngspice replay after adding immutable evidence binding and raw-log parsing.

learnings.title: Solver independence is not model independence
learnings.note: The replay now enforces the external evidence boundary by pinning and parsing raw solver artifacts.

residual_risks: The live SPICE model remains intentionally limited to initialized ideal CCM frozen-phase behavior and does not qualify thermal ampacity, control-loop behavior, losses, saturation, transients, or local sharing.
testing_gaps: No new build or test was run by this review; existing tamper, clean fixture, live-oracle, and full-suite artifacts were inspected.

finding_resolved.resolution: SHA-256 pin covers the six decks/logs, result summary, and ngspice version; raw logs are parsed and each summary measurement must match its log before comparison with fresh production moments.

evidence: /private/tmp/zapote-spice-tamper-before.log: old replay accepted the 1000x L-value mutation
/private/tmp/zapote-spice-tamper-after.log: strengthened replay rejected the identical mutation at the immutable hash assertion
coverage.live_output_safety: verify_pfc_spice uses fs::create_dir on the requested output directory, so an existing pinned fixture directory cannot be overwritten; Makefile creates only the parent.
review_limitations: Read-only follow-up; no repository edits, builds, or git writes.
No additional reviewer roster was dispatched because this was a focused resolution check.
